pool.domain: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
pool.text: If \( 4x - 6 = 14 \), what is the value of \( 2x \)?
pool.sol: \[ 4x=20 \Rightarrow x=5 \Rightarrow 2x=10 \]

pool.domain: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
pool.text: During an acoustic calibration test, two coupled variables \( x \) and \( y \) satisfy stage #1 balance equations \( 2x + 3y = 22 \) and \( 5x - 3y = 13 \). Based on this relationship, what is the combined value of \( x + y \)?
pool.sol: Add the two equations to eliminate \( y \): \[ 7x = 35 \implies x = 5. \] Substitute \( x = 5 \) into \( 2x + 3y = 22 \): \[ 3y = 12 \implies y = 4. \] Therefore, \( x + y = 5 + 4 = 9 \).

pool.text: If \( f(x) = x^2 + 2x \) and \( g(x) = x - 3 \), for what value of \( x \) does \( f(g(x)) = 0 \)?

pool.domain: One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error
pool.text: A researcher wants to estimate a population proportion with a margin of error of at most \( \pm 2\% \) at a 95% confidence level. An earlier study with \( n = 400 \) had a margin of error of \( \pm 5\% \). Approximately what sample size \( n \) is required?
pool.sol: \( \text{MOE} \propto 1/\sqrt{n} \implies \dfrac{\text{MOE}_1}{\text{MOE}_2} = \sqrt{\dfrac{n_2}{n_1}} \implies \dfrac{5}{2} = \sqrt{\dfrac{n_2}{400}} \implies 2.5^2 = \dfrac{n_2}{400} \implies 6.25 \times 400 = 2,500 \).

pool.domain: One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error
pool.text: A data set \( X \) has mean \( \mu \) and standard deviation \( \sigma \). A new data set \( Y \) is formed by the transformation \( y_i = 3x_i - 5 \) for each value in \( X \). What are the mean and standard deviation of \( Y \)?
pool.sol: Linear transformation properties: \( E(3X - 5) = 3\mu - 5 \). The constant \( -5 \) does not affect spread, while multiplication by 3 scales standard deviation: \( \text{SD}(3X - 5) = |3|\sigma = 3\sigma \).

pool.domain: One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error
pool.text: A survey of 1,200 households reported that 45% have a streaming subscription, with a margin of error of \( \pm 2.8\% \). If the survey were repeated with 300 households, what would be the expected margin of error?
pool.sol: Reducing sample size from 1,200 to 300 divides \( n \) by 4. Since \( \text{MOE} \propto 1/\sqrt{n} \), dividing \( n \) by 4 multiplies the margin of error by \( \sqrt{4} = 2 \): \( 2.8\% \times 2 = 5.6\% \).

pool.domain: One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error
pool.text: A data set of 100 observations has a mean of 50 and standard deviation 10. According to Chebyshev's inequality, at least what percentage of the data must lie between 30 and 70?
pool.sol: The interval 30 to 70 is \( 50 \pm 2(10) \), which is \( k = 2 \) standard deviations from the mean. Chebyshev's inequality guarantees that at least \( 1 - 1/k^2 = 1 - 1/4 = 3/4 = 75\% \) of data lies within 2 standard deviations for ANY distribution.

pool.text: What is the remainder when the polynomial \( f(x) = 3x^4 - 2x^3 + 5x - 7 \) is divided by \( x - 2 \)?
pool.sol: By the Remainder Theorem, the remainder when \( f(x) \) is divided by \( x - 2 \) is simply \( f(2) \). Calculate: \( f(2) = 3(2)^4 - 2(2)^3 + 5(2) - 7 = 3(16) - 2(8) + 10 - 7 = 48 - 16 + 10 - 7 = 35 \).

pool.text: For what value of \( x \) is the rational function \( f(x) = \dfrac{7}{2x - 10} \) undefined?

pool.text: If \( f(x) = x^2 + 2x \) and \( g(x) = 2x + 9 \), for what positive value of \( x \) does \( f(x) = g(x) \)?

pool.text: A rational function \( g(x) = \dfrac{3x^2 - 12}{x^2 - 4} \) has a removable discontinuity (hole) at \( x = 2 \). What is the value of the function as \( x \) approaches 2?

pool.text: In a recipe, the ratio of flour to sugar is 5:2. If 10 cups of flour are used, how many cups of sugar are needed?
pool.sol: Set up a proportion: \( \dfrac{\text{flour}}{\text{sugar}} = \dfrac{5}{2} = \dfrac{10}{s} \). Cross-multiply: \( 5s = 20 \implies s = 4 \) cups.

pool.text: A shirt originally priced at \$80 is on sale for 25% off. What is the sale price of the shirt in dollars?
pool.sol: Calculate 25% of \$80: \( 0.25 \times 80 = 20 \). Subtract from the original price: \( 80 - 20 = 60 \) dollars.

pool.text: A car travels 180 miles in 3 hours at a constant speed. At this rate, how many miles will the car travel in 5 hours?
pool.sol: The speed of the car is \( \dfrac{180}{3} = 60 \) miles per hour. In 5 hours, it travels \( 60 \times 5 = 300 \) miles.

pool.text: If 15% of a number \( n \) is 45, what is the value of \( n \)?

pool.text: A map has a scale where 1 inch represents 25 miles. If two cities are 6 inches apart on the map, what is the actual distance between them in miles?
pool.sol: Multiply the map distance by the scale factor: \( 6 \times 25 = 150 \) miles.

pool.text: The price of an item increased by 20%, and then the new price was discounted by 10%. If the original price was \$50, what is the final price in dollars?
pool.sol: After the 20% increase: \( 50 \times (1 + 0.20) = 50 \times 1.20 = 60 \). After the 10% discount on \$60: \( 60 \times (1 - 0.10) = 60 \times 0.90 = 54 \) dollars.

pool.text: A line of best fit for a scatterplot relating study time \( x \) (hours) to exam score \( y \) is given by \( y = 6.5x + 48 \). What is the predicted exam score for a student who studies 6 hours?
pool.sol: Substitute \( x = 6 \) into the model equation: \( y = 6.5(6) + 48 = 39 + 48 = 87 \).

pool.text: Machine A can produce 120 parts per hour, and Machine B can produce 180 parts per hour. Working together simultaneously, how many minutes will it take both machines to produce a total of 250 parts?
pool.sol: Combined production rate per hour is \( 120 + 180 = 300 \) parts per hour. In parts per minute, the rate is \( \dfrac{300}{60} = 5 \) parts per minute. To produce 250 parts, the time required is \( \dfrac{250}{5} = 50 \) minutes.

pool.text: In a sample of 250 students, 60% participate in after-school sports. Of those athletes, 40% are seniors. How many seniors in the sample participate in after-school sports?
pool.sol: Number of student athletes: \( 250 \times 0.60 = 150 \). Number of senior athletes: \( 150 \times 0.40 = 60 \).

pool.text: If \( a \) is 40% greater than \( b \), and \( b \) is 25% less than 120, what is the value of \( a \)?
pool.sol: First calculate \( b \): \( b = 120 \times (1 - 0.25) = 120 \times 0.75 = 90 \). Then calculate \( a \): \( a = 90 \times (1 + 0.40) = 90 \times 1.40 = 126 \).

pool.text: A solution of 40 liters contains 15% salt. How many liters of pure water must be added to dilute the solution to a 10% salt concentration?
pool.sol: Amount of pure salt in the original solution: \( 40 \times 0.15 = 6 \) liters. Let \( w \) be the liters of pure water added. The total volume becomes \( 40 + w \), and the salt concentration is \( \dfrac{6}{40 + w} = 0.10 \). Multiply both sides: \( 6 = 0.10(40 + w) \implies 6 = 4 + 0.1w \implies 2 = 0.1w \implies w = 20 \) liters.

pool.text: A cyclist travels uphill for 12 miles at an average speed of 8 mph, and then returns downhill along the same 12-mile route at an average speed of 24 mph. What is the average speed, in mph, for the entire round trip?
pool.sol: Average speed is total distance divided by total time. Total distance: \( 12 + 12 = 24 \) miles. Time uphill: \( \dfrac{12}{8} = 1.5 \) hours. Time downhill: \( \dfrac{12}{24} = 0.5 \) hours. Total time: \( 1.5 + 0.5 = 2.0 \) hours. Average speed: \( \dfrac{24}{2} = 12 \) mph.

pool.text: In a scatterplot, the actual value of \( y \) for \( x = 5 \) is 42. If the line of best fit is \( \hat{y} = 4.2x + 18 \), what is the value of the residual for this data point?
pool.sol: The residual is defined as \( \text{Actual } y - \text{Predicted } \hat{y} \). First find the predicted value: \( \hat{y} = 4.2(5) + 18 = 21 + 18 = 39 \). The residual is \( 42 - 39 = 3 \).

pool.text: A retailer buys an item at wholesale price \( W \), marks it up by 60% for retail, and then sells it during a clearance sale at a 25% discount off the retail price. If the final sale price is \$72, what was the original wholesale price \( W \) in dollars?
pool.sol: Retail price: \( 1.60W \). Clearance sale price: \( 1.60W \times (1 - 0.25) = 1.60W \times 0.75 = 1.20W \). Set equal to \$72: \( 1.20W = 72 \implies W = \dfrac{72}{1.20} = 60 \) dollars.

pool.text: Two runners run around a 400-meter circular track in opposite directions starting from the same point at the same time. Runner A runs at 5 m/s and Runner B runs at 3 m/s. How many seconds will elapse before they pass each other for the first time?
pool.sol: Because they run toward each other, their relative speed of approach is the sum of their speeds: \( 5 + 3 = 8 \) m/s. The total distance between them along the track is 400 meters. The time until they meet is \( t = \dfrac{400}{8} = 50 \) seconds.

pool.domain: One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error
pool.text: A research study surveyed 900 adults and reported a 95% confidence interval for the mean daily exercise time with a margin of error of 2.4 minutes. If the researchers want to reduce the margin of error to 1.2 minutes at the same confidence level, what total sample size is required?

pool.text: A bag contains 7 red marbles, 5 blue marbles, and 8 green marbles. If one marble is drawn at random, what is the probability that it is blue?
pool.sol: Total marbles = \( 7 + 5 + 8 = 20 \). The probability of drawing a blue marble is \( \dfrac{5}{20} = \dfrac{1}{4} = 0.25 \).

pool.text: If the probability that a flight arrives on time is 0.82, what is the probability that the flight does NOT arrive on time?
pool.sol: By the complement rule: \( P(\text{not on time}) = 1 - P(\text{on time}) = 1 - 0.82 = 0.18 \).

pool.text: A fair six-sided die with faces numbered 1 through 6 is rolled once. What is the probability of rolling a number greater than 4?
pool.sol: The numbers greater than 4 on a standard die are 5 and 6 (2 outcomes out of 6). The probability is \( \dfrac{2}{6} = \dfrac{1}{3} \approx 0.33 \). (Accept 1/3 or 0.33).

pool.text: In a group of 80 students, 32 are enrolled in French. What is the probability that a randomly chosen student from the group is enrolled in French?
pool.sol: Probability = \( \dfrac{32}{80} = \dfrac{4}{10} = 0.4 \).

pool.text: A spinner is divided into 8 equal sectors numbered 1 through 8. What is the probability that the spinner lands on an odd number?
pool.sol: The odd numbers are 1, 3, 5, 7 (4 sectors). Probability = \( \dfrac{4}{8} = 0.5 \).

pool.text: Two independent events \( A \) and \( B \) have probabilities \( P(A) = 0.4 \) and \( P(B) = 0.5 \). What is the probability that both events occur, \( P(A \text{ and } B) \)?
pool.sol: For independent events, \( P(A \text{ and } B) = P(A) \times P(B) = 0.4 \times 0.5 = 0.20 \).

pool.text: In a table of 120 patients, 48 are male. Among the males, 12 test positive. What is the conditional probability that a randomly selected male patient tests positive?
pool.sol: The condition restricts the sample space to male patients (48 total). Conditional probability = \( \dfrac{12}{48} = \dfrac{1}{4} = 0.25 \).

pool.text: A bag contains 4 red balls and 6 green balls. Two balls are drawn at random without replacement. What is the probability that both balls are red?

pool.text: In a survey of 200 adults, 120 own a smartphone, 80 own a tablet, and 50 own both. What is the probability that a randomly chosen adult owns either a smartphone or a tablet?

pool.text: A medical diagnostic test has a 95% sensitivity (true positive rate) and a 90% specificity (true negative rate). In a population where 2% have the disease, what is the probability that a randomly tested individual tests positive?

pool.text: Events \( A \) and \( B \) satisfy \( P(A \mid B) = 0.6 \), \( P(B) = 0.4 \), and \( P(A) = 0.5 \). What is the value of \( P(B \mid A) \)?

pool.text: A fair coin is flipped 4 times. What is the probability of getting exactly 3 heads?
pool.sol: Number of total outcomes = \( 2^4 = 16 \). Number of ways to get exactly 3 heads = \( \binom{4}{3} = 4 \). Probability = \( \dfrac{4}{16} = \dfrac{1}{4} = 0.25 \).

pool.text: In a factory, Machine X produces 60% of all components and Machine Y produces 40%. The defective rate is 2% for Machine X and 5% for Machine Y. If a component is chosen at random, what is the probability, as a decimal, that it is defective?
pool.sol: By the law of total probability: \( P(\text{Defective}) = (0.60)(0.02) + (0.40)(0.05) = 0.012 + 0.020 = 0.032 \).

pool.text: A card is drawn from a standard deck of 52 cards. Given that the card is a red card, what is the probability that it is an ace?
pool.sol: There are 26 red cards in a standard deck (hearts and diamonds). Exactly 2 of these red cards are aces (Ace of hearts, Ace of diamonds). Conditional probability = \( \dfrac{2}{26} = \dfrac{1}{13} \approx 0.077 \). (Accept 1/13 or 0.077).

pool.text: A right triangle has legs of length 6 and 8. What is the length of its hypotenuse?

pool.text: A circle has radius 7. What is the circumference of the circle divided by \( \pi \)?

pool.text: A rectangle has length 15 and width 8. What is the area of the rectangle?

pool.text: In right triangle \( ABC \), angle \( C = 90^\circ \). If \( \sin A = 0.6 \), what is the value of \( \cos B \)?
pool.sol: In any right triangle, the acute angles are complementary: \( A + B = 90^\circ \). By the cofunction identity, \( \cos B = \sin(90^\circ - B) = \sin A = 0.6 \).

pool.text: A cube has an edge length of 4 cm. What is the volume of the cube in cubic centimeters?
pool.sol: Volume of a cube is \( s^3 = 4^3 = 64 \text{ cm}^3 \).

pool.text: The equation of a circle in the \( xy \)-plane is \( (x - 5)^2 + (y + 2)^2 = 81 \). What is the radius of the circle?
pool.sol: In standard circle form \( (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2 \), the constant on the right side represents \( r^2 \). Thus \( r^2 = 81 \implies r = 9 \).

pool.text: The equation \( x^2 + y^2 - 8x + 6y = 0 \) represents a circle in the \( xy \)-plane. What is the radius of this circle?

pool.text: A regular hexagon has perimeter 36. What is the area of the hexagon divided by \( \sqrt{3} \)?
pool.sol: Each side has length \( s = \dfrac{36}{6} = 6 \). A regular hexagon consists of 6 equilateral triangles of side 6. Area = \( 6 \times \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{4}s^2 = 6 \times \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{4}(36) = 6 \times 9\sqrt{3} = 54\sqrt{3} \). Dividing by \( \sqrt{3} \) yields 54.

pool.text: In circle \( O \), central angle \( \angle AOB \) measures \( 120^\circ \). If the area of sector \( AOB \) is \( 12\pi \), what is the radius of circle \( O \)?
pool.sol: Sector area formula: \( A = \dfrac{\theta}{360^\circ}\pi r^2 \implies 12\pi = \dfrac{120}{360}\pi r^2 \implies 12\pi = \dfrac{1}{3}\pi r^2 \implies 12 = \dfrac{1}{3}r^2 \implies r^2 = 36 \implies r = 6 \).

pool.text: A right cone has base radius 5 and slant height 13. What is the volume of the cone divided by \( \pi \)?
pool.sol: Find the vertical height using the Pythagorean theorem: \( h = \sqrt{13^2 - 5^2} = \sqrt{169 - 25} = \sqrt{144} = 12 \). Volume of a cone: \( V = \dfrac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h = \dfrac{1}{3}\pi (5^2)(12) = \dfrac{1}{3}\pi (25)(12) = 100\pi \). Dividing by \( \pi \) gives 100.

pool.text: In triangle \( ABC \), side \( AB = 10 \), side \( AC = 14 \), and the measure of angle \( A \) is \( 30^\circ \). What is the area of triangle \( ABC \)?

pool.text: The system \( y = x^2 + 5x + c \) and \( y = x + 1 \) has exactly one point of intersection. When graphed in Desmos, what value of the slider \( c \) produces this single point of tangency?

pool.text: In Desmos, the cubic polynomial \( f(x) = x^3 - 3x^2 - 9x + 27 \) has a local minimum. What is the \( x \)-coordinate of this local minimum?

pool.text: What is the total number of distinct real solutions to the equation \( \sin(x) = \dfrac{x}{10} \) when graphed in Desmos for all real numbers \( x \)?
